reply.text: {"say":"A full upper-body session pressing and pulling from both angles, with arms at the end, then battle ropes to finish and get your heart rate up.","title":"Upper Body + Finisher","days":[{"name":"Upper Body","exercises":[{"key":"barbell-bench-press","sets":4,"reps":6,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Shoulder blades pinned, touch mid-chest.LLM"},{"key":"cable-lat-pulldown","sets":4,"reps":8,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Drive elbows to your back pockets."},{"key":"seated-dumbbell-shoulder-press","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Ribs down, press straight up."},{"key":"dumbbell-chest-supported-row","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Pause with a squeeze at the top."},{"key":"dumbbell-lateral-raise","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Lead with the elbows."},{"key":"ez-bar-biceps-curl","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Elbows still at your sides."},{"key":"cable-rope-pushdown","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Spread the rope at lockout."},{"key":"battle-rope-alternating-waves","sets":4,"reps":30,"repsTo":0,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Fast arms, stay low, short rests."}]}],"unmet":[]}
